simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שַׁיִן (H7890) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שַׁיִן (shayin) means urine First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 18 27.

definitions.full: H7890. shayin or shen [ שֵׁין שַׁ֫יִן, ] noun [masculine] urine ; — plural suffix שֵׁינֵיהֶם 2Kin 18:27 = Isa 36:12 (both Kt; Qr רַגְלֵיהֶם מֵימֵי ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to urinate ;
